slug: 2026-06-17 Government data silos threaten Nigeria's AI ambitions

facts.fact: TechCabal reports that NITDA said it is working through the National Cloud Policy and developing data-exchange frameworks, and an NITDA official said the process is proving complex and 'will take longer than we anticipated'; the article does not say whether the policy was adopted, and the as_of date is the Tuesday AI Summit remarks before the 2026-06-17 publication.
